caption: The drawing features a stylized floral design centered on a light beige or cream background. The central element is a large, multi-petaled flower with elongated yellow and light orange petals radiating outward, interspersed with red, pink, and purple petal segments and rounded tips. Surrounding this main flower are smaller, abstract leaf and floral shapes in shades of green, teal, yellow, pink, red, and lavender. Two large, curved green leaves emerge symmetrically from the lower section, decorated with wavy edges. The composition is dominated by intertwined, curving stems and clusters of varied small, rounded and elongated shapes in similar colors. The overall arrangement is symmetrical, with balanced, mirrored elements extending from the center. The artwork is composed of flat, solid blocks of color with no shading or gradients, and all the elements are arranged against a plain, untextured background.
title: Design from Proposed Portfolio
